items.title: CXI - HRIS
items.description: HRIS that was built for the CXI Services Inc custom process, policy and feature.

caseStudy.overview: CXI Services Inc are still relying on manual payroll, attendance capturing using tracker, and formulated computation to generate the accurate DTR for all their agent.
caseStudy.problem: They are still using manual computation for their payroll. This also include the OT incentives, honorarium, master filing, 201 Filing, and Employee Relation.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a Web system that caters all the process that align in the CXI Services Inc. It's like a 1 stop shop web site that all tools needed not just for HRIS but to capture and track performance.
caseStudy.challenges: Diverse and complicated policy and process. Time keeping Record, and the Master filing with history feature a timeline view of your employment.
caseStudy.outcome: 500+ users are currently using the HRIS with payroll parallel testing of 95% accuracy the difference is with the discrepancy with their attendance record.
